- Quote from Elena: 'We want predictable token spend and a clear migration path from hosted to Dedicated with minimal app changes.'
- Action items: schedule cost-optimization workshop (billing + SE + product + finance), deliver sample cost model with batching/caching scenarios, set up SAML test tenant, provide Dedicated sizing guide and breakout of committed vs burst pricing.
